title: Reverse-Engineering Cursor's Prompt: Lessons in AI Prompting
summary: Analysis of Cursor's system prompts and tool-calling architecture, revealing techniques like XML tag organization, agent autonomy instructions, dual user prompts for custom instructions vs. live context, and practical constraints for cost optimization.
when-to-read: Read this when building or debugging an AI system prompt that needs to be effective at complex, multi-step tasks and tool use. Distinguish this from general AI prompt engineering by focusing on architectural patterns for production AI agents rather than one-off prompt optimization.
